title: BioIVT: DIN is text up to 30 characters, nothing else restricted
description: Gives every DIN question (DIN and Follow-up DIN, both studies) the same rule: text, at most 30 characters, no pattern. The longest DINs seen are 18 characters in the Detroit data (81,272 participants; lengths 8 to 18, most 12 to 16) and 15 in the Carlsbad data (for example 002-6504-660002); 30 leaves headroom because only the ten most common Detroit lengths were available.
rationale: Dan's decision: the longest existing DIN and the least restrictive type, applied to every DIN field. A first cap of 15 (Carlsbad only) would have blocked about 13% of Detroit DIN values (lengths 16 and 18), so it was raised to 30.

set.field.constraint_message: A DIN can be at most 30 characters.

source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan
